name: maiden panic!
source:
Maiden Panic! is a yuri VN where the player takes control of Hinoka, the student council president of an all-girls school. She and her classmates will live some hilarious situations while taking care of the school. 

[edited from [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VisualNovel/MaidenPanic]TVTropes[/url]]
translation:
《Maiden Panic!》是一部百合视觉小说。玩家扮演女子学校的学生会长远明寺妃华，与同学们一边管理学校，一边经历各种令人捧腹的状况。

[根据 [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VisualNovel/MaidenPanic]TVTropes[/url]编辑]
